2. The app

Voice Sales Register helps you keep bills and sales records on your own phone. It is free to use. We may change, improve or stop features, and we try to announce important changes in the app.

3. Your responsibilities

  • Check each bill before you give it to a customer or save it. Voice recognition and menu reading can make mistakes.
  • Set your own prices and keep them correct.
  • Save backup files regularly. Your records are only on your phone, and we cannot recover them.
  • Keep your owner PIN and your phone's screen lock private.
  • Use the app only for lawful business, and follow the tax and other laws that apply to you.
